description: Quality of Life mod for Minebounds prisons server

A comprehensive client-side quality-of-life mod for the **Minebound** Minecraft server. Track your earnings, monitor prestige progression, locate collectibles with waypoints, and streamline your chat — all from a sleek in-game overlay.

Everything is accessible through an in-game interface, toggled with **INSERT** or the `/mbqol` command.

---

## ✅ Features

### Collectible Waypoints
Find every collectible across the server with visual indicators rendered through walls.

- Box outlines on collectible locations
- Name tags with live distance display
- **28+ collectible types** across 6 locations — Desert, Sculk City, Volcano, Swamp, Spawn, and Amethyst Forest
- Remembers discovered positions across sessions
- Automatically tracks which collectibles you've already claimed
- Per-type and per-location filtering with bulk enable/disable
- Configurable colors, render distance (16–512m), and hide-claimed toggle

![collectible waypoints gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4505b51a187f4b5cc250a62df8019f145ff12ea9.png)

### Earnings Tracker
Know exactly how much you're making per hour.

- Tracks **money**, **tokens**, and **mining XP** from chat messages in real-time
- Displays totals and per-hour rates in a compact HUD overlay
- Smart pause/resume — auto-pauses after inactivity, resumes on new earnings
- Configurable pause timeout, auto-reset timeout, and manual reset button

![example of trackers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7d5d81c7fe3d58a52cf02fe4ffd0d0b7c3a11da.png)

### Prestige Progression Overlay
Always know how far you are from your next rank or prestige.

- Shows current prestige level, rank (A–Z), and balance
- Calculates remaining cost to next rank or prestige
- Progress bar with percentage to next prestige
- ETA based on your current earnings rate

### Chat QOL
Small improvements that add up.

- **Chat Binds** — bind any key to send a message or command
- **Auto-Sell** — automatically runs `/sell` when your inventory hits a configurable threshold
- **Minimal Sell Messages** — condenses sell confirmations to `+$Y (X items)`
- **Action Bar to Chat** — redirects action bar messages into chat so you never miss them

![chat keybind showcase!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4e4598305f89af5253df9e72de23ac95f84b2dc.png)

Toggle fullbright from the Overlays menu.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use) for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
3. Drop the jar into your `mods` folder

---

## ⌨️ Controls

| Control | Action |
|---|---|
| `INSERT` | Open/close the configuration GUI |
| `/mbqol` | Open/close the configuration GUI |
| Custom chat binds | Send configured messages or commands |

All settings are saved automatically.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This mod is designed for use on the Minebound server. Features like scoreboard parsing, prestige calculations, and collectible detection are tailored to Minebound's specific systems and may not function on other servers.
